decision_from_ablation: The rectangle loses completion under allocation-only but retains it under relocation-only. Preserve original pressure law outside an acknowledged handoff pair; do not reuse v1 normalized NNLS pressure weights.
scope: One minimal development candidate, default off. No attachment, pulling, new sensor, physics/safety/success threshold or progress/phase change.

permissions.own: Local fused map, observed normal/gap, own estimated displacement and velocity, own prior press command, task direction/distance
permissions.received: Existing one-hop neighbour positions and immutable previous-frame handoff messages; no forwarding or reading private maps
permissions.supervision: Existing common phase and team-estimate supervisor retained and disclosed; not fully decentralized
permissions.excluded: True object pose, velocity, net forces/torque, physical contact flags, unobserved boundary, global map

states.incoming: idle -> offer -> travel -> engage -> ready -> support; any failed lease/permission -> bounded rollback
states.donor: idle -> holding original press -> trial unload -> retired; failed response/link -> original pressure law
states.ordering: Donor acknowledges one offer; incoming arrival is not confirmation; donor does not unload until local proxy is sustained; neighbours only see previous-frame messages

constants.local_target: existing v1 observed-patch screen, within local_radius, normal improvement > push_share_floor; no occupied/closer-neighbour target
constants.volunteer: outside original task-facing push arc and not previously pressing; corrective patch cannot push backward along goal
constants.confirmation: credible local motion; observed nonnegative gap <= robot_radius; previous press demand; full one-dwell median-motion window followed by one continuous dwell with forward speed > transport_deadband*reference_speed and lateral speed <= same floor when outside original cross_track_deadband
constants.trial: linear pressure-share reduction over one dwell, paused if response fails; full original share restored after one dwell of bad response
constants.trial_forward_floor: 0.8 * min(pretrial median forward speed, current original braking reference)
constants.pressure: Incoming uses original clipped dot-product share and original PI loop/QP; donor scales only its original share during trial; all other original pushers unchanged

interpretation.confirmation: Operational local proxy, not a force sensor, physical-contact certificate, individual causal attribution or complete wrench/reachability proof
interpretation.coordination: Local suppression of competing offers; no global mutual-exclusion guarantee under asymmetric/lost communication
interpretation.rollback: Communication delay and inaccessible return patch can prevent immediate/full restoration; expiry retained as a failure
interpretation.stopping: Original HOLD is not relaunched using truth; 600-second observation does not repair already settled off-target cases
interpretation.promotion: Require frozen primary development gate; retain negative results and leave default disabled otherwise
